about: ix-cosmic-ray's layers, checked by tests/test_source_layering.py on every test run with the shared checker (components/capabilities/_testing/layers.py). Three files: the generator, the one module that imports cosmic-ray; the registration, which imports none of it, so a session that only asks which sources are installed pays nothing for cosmic-ray; and the package surface. 'why' keys are read by neither checker.
scan_why: Every Python file in the package. Tests are out of scan: a test reaches cosmic-ray to check what the generator gives against what it makes.

why.cosmic_ray: its operators, its AST walk and mutate_code, as a generator library: never its init, work database, runner or distributors
why.ix.extension: the mutant source's port and records, ix's published contract, which the source is written against alone: allow admits no other ix module
why.forbid: the generator reads only the text it is given: no file, no environment, no process; and it registers nothing (the registry is matrix's)

why.matrix: type-only: the registry register() is handed
why.ix_cosmic_ray.generator: imported inside build(), when ix asks for the source, so loading the registration imports no cosmic-ray (tests/test_source.py holds it)

why.ix_cosmic_ray.source: re-exports the registration's names; importlib.metadata reads the installed version

single_importer_why: the generator is the one module that speaks cosmic-ray, so a change of its API is one file
